name: Aburame Rinko
source:
She is a senior student to the main character.

She used to be a figure skater and until recently trained in modern ballet, and has a nice, firm body.

With her endless ambition of “world domination” in mind, she is a crazy girl who tries to summon demons in her daily sabbatical.
